sourceQualification.bankVersusPublished: Different Git commits; git diff confirms no src/engine, src/compiler, LICENSE.md or AUTHORS.md changes. Only four devDependency values in package.json differ in the inspected qualification scope.
sourceQualification.inkReferenceRole: Authoring/runtime reference only; no C# compiler or Ink engine source copied into YAIRPG.

compiler.sourceNormalization: Remove one leading BOM; normalize CRLF and CR to LF. Preserve all remaining source characters.
compiler.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys and preserve array order. JSON identity hashing uses compact JSON; emitted artifact uses two-space JSON plus one LF.

metadata.storyRevision: current compiler pin; retained artifacts preserve their own revision
metadata.compiledSha256: SHA256(compact canonical standard Ink JSON before metadata)
metadata.contentHash: sha256:SHA256(compact canonical preceding metadata fields excluding contentHash)
metadata.sceneIds: Explicit list of supported scene identities included in hashed metadata

compiler.diagnosticsPolicy: Any compiler error, warning or author message rejects emission.
compiler.includesPolicy: Single root source only. INCLUDE is rejected; the in-memory JsonFileHandler exposes only the root filename.
compiler.checkPolicy: --check recompiles in memory, compares exact output bytes and never writes.
compiler.packageRootOverride: --package-root PATH or INKJS_PACKAGE_ROOT; direct inkjs package directory or an installation root containing node_modules/inkjs.
compiler.hostFunctionPolicy: EXTERNAL and RANDOM/SEED_RANDOM/LIST_RANDOM rejected before compilation; all effects are registered host response bindings.
compiler.choiceBindingPolicy: All47 stable response tags must be present uniquely in evaluated choice-only compiled strings before choice points. Output-only tags fail compilation.

formatCompatibility.runtimeSaveMaximumGuard: Engine does not guard a future maximum; YAIRPG must supply the exact format check.
formatCompatibility.cursorOwnership: Ink GM adapter and Features optional validator join, in the same existing durable host envelope as game consequences.
formatCompatibility.missingOldCursor: Absent/default null; no load or render enrollment.
formatCompatibility.contentChangePolicy: Keep immutable v1/v2 artifacts for exact old active cursors. Match content/hash/scene per record. Scoped wrapper2 explicit first-scoped-commit migration preserves legacy1 without effects. No render/load migration.
formatCompatibility.scopeLimit: Static bounds and recipe are verified. Scene/cursor/host save, reload, interruption and failure behavior remain deferred.
formatCompatibility.randomPolicy: No narrative RNG/callback owns rewards, costs or host outcomes. Host commands and saved host draws remain authoritative.

notices.distributionRecipe: Features copies the marked inkjs-notice and inkjs-authors blocks to dist/INKJS_NOTICE.txt and dist/INKJS_AUTHORS.txt alongside bundled runtime. The complete exact Node copy recipe is in COMPILER.md.

featuresOwnedJoins.dependency: Add exact dependencies.inkjs=2.4.0 and lock the recorded tarball integrity in the exclusive package/lock window.
featuresOwnedJoins.build: Compile the parent-authored source once; add ink:check before esbuild so source/artifact/compiler drift fails the build. Keep compiler out of browser imports.
featuresOwnedJoins.notice: Copy both marked notices during each build and include them in distribution artifacts.
featuresOwnedJoins.runtime: Import the ESM runtime via 'inkjs'; import compiled JSON as a JSON module for esbuild.
featuresOwnedJoins.save: Use Ink GM adapter's exact format/content/cursor validation and one existing durable host publication path.
